blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Two motorcycle riders died in a road accident in Antipolo City in Rizal on Wednesday, the Calabarzon police said. A 24-year-old man was driving the motorcycle with a 29-year-old woman riding pillion along a downhill curved portion of the road early Wednesday morning.
